pageDesc: Predict the score of 5 selected matches every week, earn points and climb the weekly and season rankings. Free, not betting, no prizes.

hero.title: Predict the score, be the best of the week.
hero.sub: Free. Not betting. 5 selected matches every week.
hero.guest: Fill in now, sign in when you save.

s2.title: Predict the score
s2.text: Change it until kick-off. Put your joker on one match.

how.title: How to play
how.example: You predict 2-1, it ends 3-2 → result 3 + difference 1 = 4 points.

scoring.dirC: Home win / draw / away win correct
scoring.diffC: Result correct and goal difference correct (every draw is 0)
scoring.rareC: Exact score and 5% or fewer predicted it (with at least 30 predictions)
scoring.jokerC: One match a week; that match's points are doubled
scoring.max: Up to 10 points per match, 20 with the joker. Up to 60 points a week.

rules.title: Rules and scoring
rules.lock: Each match locks at its own kick-off. After that, the prediction and joker can't change; the clock is kept on the server.
rules.week: The week starts Monday 00:00 and ends Sunday 23:59 (Turkey time).
rules.regular: The score is the regular-time score (90 minutes plus stoppage time). Extra time and penalties don't count.
rules.void: A postponed match still counts if it's played within the week. A match moved outside the week, cancelled, abandoned or awarded is void: everyone gets 0 and a joker on it is lost.
rules.tiebreak: Ties are broken by: more exact scores, more correct results, earlier last change.
rules.visible: To appear in the rankings you need a nickname and a verified email (Google accounts are verified).
rules.noPrize: {{game}} is free and has no prizes: no money is deposited, no money or gifts are won. Only points and rankings.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a2: No. No money is deposited and there are no prizes; only points and rankings.
faq.a3: One tap with Google, or with your existing account.
faq.a5: As often as you like until that match kicks off.
